svg.text: builder turtle on its home block
wireless or ender modem, some coal
full-block wired modem on the supply chest
wired modem on the storage cable
its twin as the supply chest
• Then tap Build on the projector (or use build-control). The building can be up to 256 blocks away.
• Needs GPS: it steps forward once to find its facing, so leave room in front.
• Use the linkable kind of ender chest (EnderStorage): a vanilla one belongs to a player and CC can't see into it.
